oil.when: 2024 (Service Interval items in the cluster User Settings)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
Park and keep the engine running so the battery does not run down while you change settings.
Press the Mode button to step through the cluster display modes until User Settings shows.
Open Convenience, then the Service Interval items, and choose Reset.
Check that the Service in message shows a full interval again.
oil.note: Checked in the 2024 Carnival owner's manual, which says to see a Kia dealer to use the service interval menu. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.
